title: Prophecies Against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia

questions.question: Against which nation does Ezekiel prophesy first in chapter 25?
options: The Ammonites
The Philistines
The Egyptians
The Tyre and Sidonians
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:2 (ESV): "Son of man, set your face toward the Ammonites and prophesy against them."

questions.question: Why is God bringing judgment on the Ammonites?
options: Because they said "Aha!" over God's sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was made desolate
Because they stole the Ark of the Covenant
Because they refused bread and water to the Israelites entirely
Because they worshiped Dagon in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: Because they said "Aha!" over God's sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was made desolate
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:3 (ESV): "Say to the Ammonites... Because you said, 'Aha!' over my sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was made desolate,"

questions.question: To whom will God hand the Ammonites over for a possession?
options: To the people of the East
To the Babylonians permanently
To the Egyptians for slaves
To the surviving Israelites
questions.correctAnswer: To the people of the East
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:4 (ESV): "therefore, behold, I am handing you over to the people of the East for a possession,"

questions.question: What will the capital city of Ammon (Rabbah) become?
options: A pasture for camels, and a fold for flocks
A heap of burning brimstone
A salt pit forever
A great monument to God's wrath
questions.correctAnswer: A pasture for camels, and a fold for flocks
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:5 (ESV): "I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels and Ammon a fold for flocks. Then you will know that I am the Lord."

questions.question: What physical actions did the Ammonites do showing their "malice of soul" against the land of Israel?
options: They clapped their hands, stamped their feet, and rejoiced with all the malice within them
They blew trumpets of victory
They spit on the borders of Judah
They paid mercenaries to attack the stragglers
questions.correctAnswer: They clapped their hands, stamped their feet, and rejoiced with all the malice within them
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:6 (ESV): "Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet and rejoiced with all the malice within you against the land of Israel,"

questions.question: Which two nations are mentioned together in verse 8 as saying, "Behold, the house of Judah is like all the other nations"?
options: Moab and Seir
Edom and Ammon
Tyre and Sidon
Egypt and Cush
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:8 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: Because Moab and Seir said, 'Behold, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,'"

questions.question: What will God do to the cities on the frontier of Moab, the glory of the country?
options: He will lay open the flank of Moab from the cities... and give it along with Ammon to the people of the East
He will cause an earthquake to swallow them
He will rain hail and fire on them
He will dry up all their wells
questions.correctAnswer: He will lay open the flank of Moab from the cities... and give it along with Ammon to the people of the East
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:9-10 (ESV): "therefore I will lay open the flank of Moab... I will give it along with the Ammonites to the people of the East as a possession,"

questions.question: Why is judgment pronounced upon Edom?
options: Because Edom acted revengefully against the house of Judah and has grievously offended in taking vengeance on them
Because Edom refused to pay tribute to the temple
Because Edom worshipped the golden calf
Because Esau sold his birthright
questions.correctAnswer: Because Edom acted revengefully against the house of Judah and has grievously offended in taking vengeance on them
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:12 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: Because Edom acted revengefully against the house of Judah and has grievously offended in taking vengeance on them,"

questions.question: God says He will lay Edom waste from Teman even to Dedan. How shall they fall?
options: By the sword
By famine
By disease
By a great terror from heaven
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:13 (ESV): "I will stretch out my hand against Edom and cut off from it man and beast. And I will make it desolate; from Teman even to Dedan they shall fall by the sword."

questions.question: By whose hand will God execute His vengeance upon Edom?
options: By the hand of His people Israel
By the hand of Nebuchadnezzar
By the hand of an angel
By the hand of the Philistines
questions.correctAnswer: By the hand of His people Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:14 (ESV): "And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they shall do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath,"

questions.question: What fourth nation is judged in chapter 25 for acting revengefully and seeking to destroy Israel with never-ending enmity?
options: The Philistines
The Babylonians
The Assyrians
The Hittites
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:15 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: Because the Philistines acted revengefully and took vengeance with malice of soul to destroy in never-ending enmity,"

questions.question: Who will God cut off along with the Philistines?
options: The Cherethites and destroy the remnant of the seacoast
The Anakim and the giants of Gath
The priests of Dagon and the lords of Ekron
The metalworkers of Ashkelon
questions.correctAnswer: The Cherethites and destroy the remnant of the seacoast
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:16 (ESV): "therefore thus says the Lord God, Behold, I will stretch out my hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the remnant of the seacoast."

questions.question: How does God say He will execute great vengeance upon the Philistines?
options: With wrathful rebukes
With a rain of hailstones
By sending madness and confusion upon them
By drying up the Great Sea
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:17 (ESV): "I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes."

questions.question: What is the recurring refraining statement at the end of each judgment in this chapter (Ammon, Moab, Edom, Philistia)?
options: "Then they will know that I am the Lord"
"And the house of Israel shall rejoice"
"Their memory shall be blotted out"
"So shall my wrath be appeased"
questions.correctAnswer: "Then they will know that I am the Lord"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 25:5, 7, 11, 14, 17 all end with (or contain) "Then they will know that I am the Lord" (or "know my vengeance").

questions.question: These four nations (Ammon, Moab, Edom, Philistia) all share what common behavior that brought God's judgment on them here?
options: They gloated over or took vengeful advantage of Judah's fall
They formed an alliance to directly attack the temple
They tried to assassinate the king of Babylon
They harbored fugitive Israelites to sell them as slaves
questions.correctAnswer: They gloated over or took vengeful advantage of Judah's fall
questions.explanation: Verses 3, 8, 12, and 15 all cite these nations mocking, gloating, or taking revenge on Judah in its time of destruction.

key_verse_text: "I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the Lord, when I lay my vengeance upon them."
